superseded_oracles.superseded_by: SF deterministic state-projection rules & text surface canonicalization
superseded_oracles.change: contract/text.normalize_phrase gained US/UK spelling normalization, cluster prefix stripping, phrase extension stripping, and tail-word singularization. sf_state_projection._repair_state_mention gained five rules: (1) PointInTime anchor missing TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent gets Since/During; (2) Duration-only mention drops stray TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent; (3) Active count tagged Since without explicit 'since' gets During; (4) Active rate mention with historical onset framing drops onset YearDate/Age; (5) Seizure-free mention forces TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent to Since. In addition, concrete numeric rates drop FrequencyChange, point anchors drop TimePeriod/NumberOfTimePeriods, and DayDate drops TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent.
